onboarding.headline: Connect your OpenClaw Gateway
onboarding.desc: Enter your gateway URL and auth token below to unlock the full dashboard.

0.title: Start your OpenClaw Gateway
0.desc: Run the gateway process on your machine. It listens on port 18789 by default.

1.title: Find your auth token
1.desc: Copy the token from your gateway config file.

2.title: Enter URL + token above
2.desc: Paste the WebSocket URL and your token, then click Connect.

validation.urlInvalid: Must start with ws:// or wss://
validation.tokenShort: Token must be at least 32 characters (operator-level access)

security.insecureWarning: Non-loopback ws:// connections are blocked. Use wss:// or connect to 127.0.0.1.
security.breakGlassAck: I understand this connection is insecure and accept the risk.

audit.title: Security Audit Log
audit.empty: No audit events in this session.
